sections.title: 1. Desk Organisation: Pen & Marker Pick-and-Place
sections.line: Picking pens and markers from the desk and placing them cleanly inside the white organiser box (~23 s autonomous cycle with stall-tick thickness sensing).

sections.title: 2. Center-Magnet Duster: Bottle-Cap Collection
sections.line: Because the magnet sits only in the dead center of the duster, the arm aligns that center 1.2 cm over each metal cap without pressing down, verifies a clear table, and drops into the box.

sections.title: 3. Hero Skill: Chained Flip-Top Lid Open & Tissue Extraction
sections.line: Catching the hinged flip-top lip in a horizontal pass, immediately indexing to the standing fold, and pulling single wet wipes straight out vertically.

sections.title: 4. Spill Cleaning & Adaptation: 5-Lane Tissue Wipe -> Smart Packet Push -> Spoon Scoop
sections.line: From wiping coffee beans in a 5-lane tissue pattern, to intelligently pushing the rigid packet sideways as a squeegee, plus dual-camera 30 fps bowl-to-cup spoon scooping.

sections.title: 5. Side-by-Side Digital Twin & 30 Hz Table-Tennis RL
sections.line: Synchronised real-vs-MuJoCo digital twin (94% cup benchmark) and our 30 Hz PPO table-tennis ball-balancing policy (95% in twin; real 12 V servos torque-limited under outstretched racket load).

items.title: First-Pass Flip-Top Lid Open & Single-Tissue Pull
items.note: One horizontal stroke at z = 10.3 cm pops the flip-top lid open, followed immediately by a top-fold pinch and straight vertical pull.

items.title: Horizontal Lip Stroke & Full Tissue Extraction
items.note: 14.5 cm constant-height lip stroke opens the hinged cap cleanly without shifting the pack, then extracts the sheet.

items.title: Precision Tip Pinch & Straight Vertical Tissue Lift
items.note: Pinches the standing tissue tip at z = 7.6 cm and pulls straight up so the pack stays on the table while one sheet comes free.

items.title: Chained Flip-Top Lid Open & Tissue Extraction
items.note: Sideways lid sweep chained directly into vertical tissue extraction with camera verification.

items.title: Closed-Loop Visual Retry: Lid Open & Tissue Lift
items.note: Camera verification detects an empty pinch and re-indexes automatically until the tissue lifts cleanly.

items.title: Packet Squeegee Sweep Clearing Spilled Coffee Beans
items.note: Uses the rigid flat side of the packet to push scattered coffee beans 21 cm across the table in one clean pass.

items.title: Five-Lane Table-Clearing Sweep Pattern
items.note: Five parallel table-level strokes with lifted returns clear over 95% of beans from the target work zone.

items.title: Wooden Spoon Scoops & Pours Coffee Beans into Black Cup
items.note: Grasps the wooden spoon from the bowl, scoops coffee beans, carries across the table, and pours cleanly into the black cup.

items.title: Wooden Spoon Bean Scoop & Pour (Run 2, Dual-Cam 30 fps)
items.note: Repeatable 30.0 fps dual-camera scoop-and-pour into the black cup.

items.title: Vision-Shifted Spork Grasp & Bean Transfer
items.note: Locates the wooden handle in RGB, shifts the trajectory to the live bowl pose, grasps under load, and scoops beans across.

items.title: Magnetic Duster Collects Metal Bottle Caps & Drops in Box
items.note: Grasps the duster first try, holds 1.2 cm over each metal cap so the magnet snaps them up with zero pressing, verifies 0 caps remain, and places in the box.

items.title: Autonomous Pen & Marker Runs (~23 s, Stall-Tick Sensing)
items.note: Camera + 7-DoF IK places markers and thin blue pens into the white box, distinguishing thin pens (1397 ticks) from thick markers (1570 ticks).

items.title: Side-by-Side Real Robot & MuJoCo 3.2.7 Digital Twin Replay
items.note: Synchronised side-by-side trajectory replay matching real follower hardware within 6.79 mm mean end-effector error.

items.title: MuJoCo 3.2.7 Twin: 94% Autonomous Cup Grasp (Front + Wrist)
items.note: Matches real arm trajectories to 6.79 mm; wrist-camera 3D ray alignment reduces +-3 cm calibration error below 5 mm.

items.title: 30 Hz PPO Policy: Sideways JOOLA Racket Ball Balancing (95%)
items.note: Matched 1:1 to our real sideways JOOLA racket grip; recovers smoothly from ball kicks under 0-100 ms camera latency.

items.title: 30 Hz PPO Policy: Continuous Racket Ball Dribbling (22 Bounces)
items.note: Rhythmic keep-up policy trained with hollow-shell ball aerodynamics and anti-buzz bounce gating.
